bullets.text: A heatwave affected Verlow and neighbouring Hetton Rise from 22 June 2026, placing sustained strain on the local electricity network.
The Provincial Public Health Institute issued a heat warning for the town on the second day and deployed to Verlow the same morning.
No casualty figures were reported during the window, although service at Verlow General Hospital was disrupted as the heat persisted.
The institute's deployment was continuing at the end of the window, with the network operator warning customers of further strain on supply.
The Provincial Public Health Institute issues a heat warning covering Verlow and Hetton Rise on the second day of the heatwave.
The institute asks for assistance with the response in Verlow.
The institute deploys to Verlow within minutes of the warning.
Reports of the deployment continue through the middle of the day and into the afternoon.
Service at Verlow General Hospital is disrupted on the fourth day of the event.
Grennet Power, the network operator, issues a warning as the window closes.
